sessions.phase_label: Initial landing-page layout, media, and content revisions
Pricing guidance and specification of remaining page variants and edits
Migration, implementation review, and responsive fixes

requirements.title: Natural Hero Block Layout
requirements.definition: Format the top hero block as a visually complete, natural-looking section whose media does not intrude into the text area.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the hero block's overall layout and text/media separation; replacing its image with a playable video is a separate media behavior.

requirements.title: Playable Hero Video
requirements.definition: Replace the hero image with the client-supplied video and ensure that the video plays in the page preview.
requirements.boundary_note: Video selection and playback are tightly coupled acceptance criteria for one media integration; the surrounding hero layout remains separate.

requirements.title: Timeline Block Separation on Black Background
requirements.definition: Present the day-range timeline section on a black background with dividing lines that clearly separate its blocks.
requirements.boundary_note: The black background and dividing lines form one coupled visual-separation mechanism; image-to-heading alignment is independently testable.

requirements.title: Timeline Image Alignment
requirements.definition: Align the images in the program timeline blocks with their corresponding headings, including the 第 1-7 天 block.
requirements.boundary_note: Image alignment can be fixed or fail independently of the timeline background and block-divider treatment.

requirements.title: Remove Week 5-6 Identity Section
requirements.definition: Remove the section titled 第 5-6 週：身份認同（陰影整合）—地圖🗺️ from the landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: This specifically identified section can be removed independently of the Q&A and bonus sections.

requirements.title: Remove Specified Q&A Box
requirements.definition: Remove the second-to-last Q&A box immediately above the final question about what to do when the user has questions.
requirements.boundary_note: The request identifies one independently removable Q&A item rather than a general page-cleanup Requirement.

requirements.title: Remove Complete Bonus Section
requirements.definition: Remove the bonus section in its entirety, including the specified header text 今天加入顯化202即可獲得以下3門加碼課程：.
requirements.boundary_note: The later header instruction clarifies completeness of the same section-removal behavior rather than introducing a separate header Requirement.

requirements.title: Two-Panel Pricing Layout
requirements.definition: Show only two pricing panels by removing the most expensive option and rebalance the layout if the removal leaves excessive side space.
requirements.boundary_note: Panel count and the resulting desktop layout form one coupled composition change; monthly typography and mobile overflow have separate acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Monthly Price Unit Typography
requirements.definition: Style each monthly price so the 月 unit is displayed in smaller type than the numeric price.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently testable typography rule and is not merely an attribute of pricing-panel count.

requirements.title: Centered Pricing Subheader
requirements.definition: Center the specified pricing subheader beneath the pricing-section header.
requirements.boundary_note: Subheader alignment can be changed or verified independently of panel count, price typography, and responsive panel fit.

requirements.title: Pricing Panels Fit Mobile Viewport
requirements.definition: Keep the pricing panels fully within the visible mobile viewport without extending out of frame.
requirements.boundary_note: Responsive viewport fit has its own failure trajectory and is separate from the desktop panel composition.

requirements.title: Duplicate Landing Page
requirements.definition: Create a duplicate of the revised landing page as a separately accessible page variant.
requirements.boundary_note: Creating the duplicate is an independent delivery action; the duplicate's required omission of pricing is a separate content-state Requirement.

requirements.title: Pricing-Free Duplicate Page
requirements.definition: Remove the pricing section entirely from the duplicate landing-page variant while retaining it on the priced variant.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement governs the duplicate's persistent content difference rather than the act of creating the duplicate.

requirements.title: Upper-Right YouTube Navigation Link
requirements.definition: Add a YouTube icon and working link in the landing page's upper-right navigation, following the referenced XianhuaAI implementation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers existence, placement, and link behavior of the base navigation control; direct visibility on mobile has a separate responsive trajectory.

requirements.title: Direct Mobile YouTube Icon Visibility
requirements.definition: Display the YouTube icon directly in the upper-right area on mobile without requiring the user to open a dropdown.
requirements.boundary_note: Mobile direct visibility can fail and be fixed independently of whether the underlying YouTube navigation link exists on desktop.

requirements.title: Pricing Color Editing Instructions
requirements.definition: Provide accessible written instructions identifying the code locations used to change pricing-panel outline and button colors.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested instructional artifact remains independently required even if no pricing colors are changed during the task.

requirements.title: Deliver Pages in Migrated Kajabi Account
requirements.definition: Ensure the revised primary and duplicate pages are present in the client's new Kajabi account, transferring work from the old account when necessary.
requirements.boundary_note: Correct-account delivery is independently required even if every page behavior works in the obsolete account; it is not generic administration.

requirements.title: Secondary Course-Content Navigation Controls
requirements.definition: Place a secondary 👇跳到課程內容介紹👇 control directly beneath each applicable primary button, without the primary button wrapper styling, and make it link to the course-content section.
requirements.boundary_note: Presence under each primary control, close spacing, secondary styling, and linkability are coupled acceptance criteria for one repeated navigation mechanism.

requirements.title: Instructor Section Alignment
requirements.definition: Restore correct alignment in the About Your Instructor section after the addition of the new photo.
requirements.boundary_note: This section-specific alignment behavior can be fixed and evaluated independently of other page layout revisions.

unresolved_candidates.description: The conversation does not fully resolve which late revisions apply to both page variants versus only the priced or duplicate page; the client rejects the freelancer's inference that all comments apply to both and asks that both pages be checked.
